title: In 1962, a Nuke Exploded in Space and Lit Up the Sky Over Hawaii

scenes.text: In 1962, America blew up a nuclear bomb in space.
It went off 250 miles up, with the power of 1.4 million tons of TNT.
900 miles away in Hawaii, around 300 streetlights went dark.
The sky glowed red like an aurora for hours.
Within months, at least a third of the satellites in orbit were damaged.
One bomb. In space. It broke things 900 miles away.

description:
On 9 July 1962 the United States detonated a 1.4 megaton nuclear bomb about 250 miles above the Pacific. The test was called Starfish Prime.
About 900 miles away in Hawaii, streetlights went out and the sky glowed red for hours. Around a third of the satellites then in orbit were damaged in the following months.
Should tests like this ever be allowed again? Tell us what you think.

first_comment: The magnetic field was pushed out of the blast area for nearly half a minute. Did you know this test ever happened?
